name: Notification System Database Storage
description: Storage submodule for notification_system: a translatable 'notification' content entity (title, body, link, priority, sticky, forced, expires, multi-user audience), an admin UI, per-user read tracking, cron expiry/purge, and the 'database' NotificationProvider. Adds a nested db_notification_provider plugin type.
project_description: The database storage submodule of notification_system. It defines a translatable 'notification' content entity type with fields for user audience, provider id, notification type, title, body, link, sticky, priority, forced and expires, plus a full admin UI (list, add/edit/delete, settings). A dedicated notification_system_database_read table tracks which user has read which notification. hook_cron deletes expired notifications, purges read records after a configurable number of days, and deletes notifications with no remaining audience. The DatabaseNotificationProvider exposes these entities through the parent module's provider system, and a nested db_notification_provider plugin type lets other modules advertise the notification types that stored notifications use.
